==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|som||obsolete}}
* {{alter|en|som'||dialect}}
* {{alter|en|sum#Determiner||original spelling|now|chiefly|AAVE}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*sem-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|som}}, {{m|enm|sum}}, from {{inh|en|ang|sum||some, a certain one}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*sum}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*sumaz||some, a certain one}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*sem-||one, whole}}. 

Cognate {{cog|sco|sum}}, {{m|sco|some||some}}, {{cog|frr|som}}, {{m|frr|sam}}, {{m|frr|säm||some}}, {{cog|fy|sommige}}, {{m|fy|somlike||some}}, dialectal {{cog|nl|som}}, {{m|nl|saom|t=some}}, standard {{cog|nl|sommige||some}}, {{cog|nds|somige||some}}, {{cog|de|-}} dialectal {{m|de|summige||some}}, {{cog|da|somme||some}}, {{cog|sv|somlig||some}}, {{cog|no|sum}}, {{m|no|som||some}}, {{cog|is|sumur||some}}, {{cog|got|𐍃𐌿𐌼𐍃||one, someone}}. More at {{l|en|same}}.

# A [[certain]] [[number]] (multiple but not all).
#: {{ux|en|'''Some''' enjoy spicy food, others prefer it milder.}}

|volume=189|issue=6|page=18|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/jul/10/geopolitics-transatlantic-trade-deal Where Dr Pangloss meets Machiavelli]
|passage=Hidden behind thickets of acronyms and gorse bushes of detail, a new great game is under way across the globe. '''Some''' call it geoeconomics, but it's geopolitics too. The current power play consists of an extraordinary range of countries simultaneously sitting down to negotiate big free trade and investment agreements.}}
# An [[indefinite]] [[quantity]].
#: {{ux|en|Can I have '''some''' of them?}}
# An [[indefinite]] [[amount]]; a [[part]]. {{n-g|Used mostly with abstract and nonliving objects.}}
#: {{ux|en|Please give me '''some''' of the cake.}}
#: {{ux|en|Everyone is wrong '''some''' of the time.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[someone|Someone]], a certain person.
#* {{RQ:King James Version|book=Ecclesiasticus|chapter=37|verse=7|passage=Euery counseller extolleth counsell; but there is '''some''' that counselleth for himselfe.}}

===Determiner===
{{en-head|det}}

# {{lb|en|stressed}} A [[nonzero]], [[unspecified]] [[proportion]] of (a bounded set of [[countable]] things): at least two.
#: {{ant|en|zero#Determiner|no#Determiner|;|a lot of#Determiner|many#Determiner|numerous#Determiner|;|countless#Determiner}}
#: {{hyper|en|multiple#Determiner|various#Determiner}}
#: {{hypo|en|;|a few#Determiner|a [[couple#English:_small number|couple]] of|a [[handful#English:_small number|handful]] of}}
#: {{cot|en|one#Determiner}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|any#Determiner}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Some''' people like camping.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Charles H Lippy|title=Faith in America [Three Volumes] [3 Volumes]: Changes, Challenges, New Directions|pageurl=http://books.google.com.br/books?id=wwim_0xE1c4C&pg=RA2-PA73#v=onepage&q&f=false|isbn=9780275986056|page=73|publisher=Greenwood Publishing Group
|passage=Many people, especially '''some''' evangelical Christians, have been less than optimistic about the Potter influence.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-20|volume=408|issue=8845|magazine=w:The Economist|titleurl=http://www.economist.com/news/business/21582001-army-new-online-courses-scaring-wits-out-traditional-universities-can-they|title=The attack of the MOOCs
|passage=Since the launch early last year of […] two Silicon Valley start-ups offering free education through MOOCs, massive open online courses, the ivory towers of academia have been shaken to their foundations. University brands built in '''some''' cases over centuries have been forced to contemplate the possibility that information technology will rapidly make their existing business model obsolete.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200717183119/https://www.economist.com/business/2013/07/20/the-attack-of-the-moocs}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2013|month=July-August|author=[http://www.americanscientist.org/authors/detail/sarah-glaz Sarah Glaz]
|titleurl=http://www.americanscientist.org/issues/pub/2013/4/ode-to-prime-numbers|title=Ode to Prime Numbers
|volume=101|issue=4|magazine=w:American Scientist
|passage='''Some''' poems, echoing the purpose of early poetic treatises on scientific principles, attempt to elucidate the mathematical concepts that underlie prime numbers. Others play with primes’ cultural associations. Still others derive their structure from mathematical patterns involving primes.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150629173127/https://www.americanscientist.org/issues/pub/2013/4/ode-to-prime-numbers}}
# A [[nonzero]], [[unspecified]] [[quantity]] or [[number]] of (an unbounded set of [[countable]] things).
#: {{ant|en|zero#Determiner|no#Determiner|;|a lot of#Determiner|many#Determiner|numerous#Determiner|;|countless#Determiner}}
#: {{hyper|en|multiple#Determiner|various#Determiner}}
#: {{hypo|en|;|a few#Determiner|a [[couple#English:_small number|couple]] of|a [[handful#English:_small number|handful]] of}}
#: {{cot|en|one#Determiner}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|any#Determiner}}
#: {{ux|en|Would you like '''some''' grapes?}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=IV|pages=58–59|pageref=58|passage=The Celebrity, by arts unknown, induced Mrs. Judge Short and two other ladies to call at Mohair on a certain afternoon when Mr. Cooke was trying a trotter on the track.{{...}}Their example was followed by others at a time when the master of Mohair was superintending in person the docking of '''some''' two-year-olds, and equally invisible.}}
#* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=XLIV|page=364|passage=In the autumn there was a row at '''some''' cement works about the unskilled labour men. A union had just been started for them and all but a few joined. One of these blacklegs was laid for by a picket and knocked out of time.}}
# An [[unspecified]] [[amount]] of (something [[uncountable]]).
#: {{ant|en|zero#Determiner|no#Determiner}}
#: {{hypo|en|a little#Determiner|a lot of#Determiner|much#Determiner}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|any#Determiner}}
#: {{ux|en|Would you like '''some''' water?}}
#: {{ux|en|After '''some''' persuasion, he finally agreed.}}
#* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=XVI|pages=130–131|pageref=130|passage=It was a joy to snatch '''some''' brief respite, jump upon a tram, and find himself in the rectory drawing–room. Listening here was as pleasant as talking; just to watch was pleasant. The young priests who lived here wore cassocks and birettas; their faces were fine and mild, yet really strong, like the rector's face; and in their intercourse with him and his wife they seemed to be brothers.}}
# {{lb|en|stressed}} A [[certain]], an [[unspecified]] or [[unknown]].
#: {{ux|en|I've just met '''some''' guy who said he knew you.}}
#: {{ux|en|The sequence S converges to zero for '''some''' initial value v.}}
#* {{RQ:Travers Cuckoo in the Nest|chapter=4|passage=By '''some''' paradoxical evolution rancour and intolerance have been established in the vanguard of primitive Christianity. Mrs. Spoker, in common with many of the stricter disciples of righteousness, was as inclement in demeanour as she was cadaverous in aspect.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-14|author=w:Jonathan Freedland
|volume=189|issue=1|page=18|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/jun/07/obama-apple-google-facebook-tainted-prism Obama's once hip brand is now tainted]
|passage=Where we once sent love letters in a sealed envelope, or stuck photographs of our children in a family album, now such private material is despatched to servers and clouds operated by people we don't know and will never meet. Perhaps we assume that our name, address and search preferences will be viewed by '''some''' unseen pair of corporate eyes, probably not human, and don't mind that much.}}
# {{lb|en|stressed}} A [[considerable]] quantity or number of.
#: {{ux|en|He had edited the paper for '''some''' years.}}
#: {{ux|en|He stopped working '''some''' time ago.}}
#* {{RQ:Dickens Great Expectations|I|II|29|{{...}} I took it, in the hope that it was not intended for early use, and would not be missed for '''some''' time.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=II|page=15|passage=We drove back to the office with '''some''' concern on my part at the prospect of so large a case. Sunning himself on the board steps, I saw for the first time Mr. Farquhar Fenelon Cooke. He was dressed out in broad gaiters and bright tweeds, like an English tourist, and his face might have belonged to Dagon, idol of the Philistines.}}
# {{lb|en|stressed}} {{cap|approximately}}, [[about]] (with a number).
#: {{ux|en|She has worked at the company for '''some''' thirty years now. (31 and two months, to be exact.)}}
#: {{ux|en|There were only '''some''' three or four cars in the lot at the time.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:National Geographic|year=1989|month=May|volume=175|number=5|title=Braving the Northwest Passage|author=Jeff MacInnis|page=594
|text=Each summer '''some''' 1,500 belugas gather in Cunningham Inlet, drawn in part by the clean sand-and-gravel bottom in the shallows.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2003|author=Richard N. Cooper|author2=Richard Layard|title=What the Future Holds: Insights from Social Science|publisher=MIT Press|isbn=9780262532044|page=129
|text=What other natural experiments might we have to test climate sensitivity? Another one that happens every year is the change in seasons. Winter predictably follows summer, being '''some''' fifteen degrees colder in the Northern Hemisphere and five degrees colder than summer in the Southern Hemisphere. The reason the Southern Hemisphere has a smaller seasonal cycle is because it has much more ocean than land,{{nb...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2023|author=J. Allen Hynek|title=The UFO Experience: Evidence Behind Close Encounters, Project Blue Book, and the Search for Answers|publisher=Red Wheel/Weiser|isbn=9781590033081|page=142
|text=the local police, who, with the investigator, reportedly placed a compass near the two signs that had rattled and found a deviation of '''some''' fifteen degrees. Placed next to the Renault in which they had come, the compass showed a deviation of only four degrees, but there was no deviation at all near the sign that had not rattled.}}
# {{lb|en|stressed}} {{n-g|Emphasizing a number.}}
#: {{ux|en|She has worked at the company for '''some''' five years now! How remarkable!}}
# {{senseid|en|a remarkable}}{{lb|en|informal|stressed}} A [[remarkable]].
#: {{ux|en|He is '''some''' acrobat!}}
#: {{ux|en|That was '''some''' speech you gave!}}

===Adverb===
{{en-adv|-}}

# Of a measurement: [[approximately]], [[roughly]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:approximately}}
#: {{ux|en|I guess he must have weighed '''some''' 90 kilos.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Some''' 30,000 spectators witnessed the feat.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Some''' 4,000 acres of land were flooded.}}
# {{lb|en|dialect}} To a certain extent, or for a certain period.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2014|author=C. R. Scott|title=Invisible War: Attack the Covenant
|passage=They walked '''some''' and talked '''some'''.}}
# {{lb|en|dialect}} {{cap|somewhat}}, a little.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1899|title=Columbus Medical Journal: A Magazine of Medicine and Surgery|page=108
|text=I felt '''some''' better and continued taking the preparation through all that day, still ad libitum, and by evening, twenty-four hours after I began its use, felt considerably improved.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1912|author=Mary Theodora Whitley|title=An Empirical Study of Certain Tests for Individual Differences|page=154
|text=Have felt '''some''' better to-day than yesterday but not quite normal. A little nervous all day. Slept better than previous night, but not so well as usual, for about 7 hrs.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2002-02-26|author=Anne McCaffrey|title=The Chronicles of Pern: First Fall|publisher=Del Rey|isbn=9780345453990|page=66
|text="She's '''some''' better," the pilot said, "but it'll be a long convalescence. Pierre's taking real good care of her. Ongola's a rock, as always, and if Joel would only stop yapping about losing so much cargo..."}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2002-10-15|origyear=????|author=Raymond Chandler|title=The Lady in the Lake, The Little Sister, The Long Goodbye, Playback: Introduction by Tom Hiney|publisher=Everyman's Library|isbn=9780375415029|page=68
|text=It looked '''some''' like Muriel, but not enough to be sure by any manner of means.}}
